_comment: Deployment Rules for DeployPipeline — configure these in Fabric UI: Pipeline → ⚙️ Deployment Rules

rules.description: Sets the Environment parameter per stage
Sets the SemanticModelId per stage (Gold_SM GUID differs by workspace)
Points Bronze Dataflow at the correct SharePoint environment
Binds semantic model to the stage-appropriate Gold_LH SQL endpoint

_howto: 2. Click ⚙️ Deployment Rules on the Dev→Prod stage boundary
3. For each rule above: select the item → choose rule type → fill in values per stage
4. Rules are applied automatically every time you deploy between stages
5. Rules for DataflowGen2 and SemanticModel require the Connection ID from Fabric Admin Portal → Connections
